title: Use a deliberate documented blocking ancestor shape across rich and compact work receipts
outcome: Use a deliberate documented blocking ancestor shape across rich and compact work receipts
acceptance: The blocking_ancestor shapes on show, compact and verbose ls, verbose next, core focus/next/inspect are deliberately defined and documented; fields preserve typed ancestor identity and correct lifecycle.
Native receipt regressions pin the admitted shapes, and TermAl's running readers are checked against actual candidate rich/core payloads before the new shapes land.

completion.summary: Documented and pinned deliberate native compact versus rich core blocking ancestor shapes, nearest non-open ancestor lifecycle including Proposed, and separate direct-parent state. Actual candidate payload checked against TermAl production reader code with scoped GO; no live reader execution claimed. Exact Rust/native regressions and full Windows gate passed, whole-input Codex/Claude pair has no Medium+; Low documentation enumeration follow-up filed separately. Independent acceptance passed 2/2 unchanged criteria. Landed and installed reviewed source; all four live stores ready.
